rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you, and that's a very welcome offer. Here's something concrete that suits a data analyst. We're starting a project called the Incident Reporting Gap. Regulators are proposing rules that require frontier AI developers to report \"serious incidents\" (e.g. a 72-hour reporting rule currently out for comment). Nobody has systematically checked which real-world incidents those definitions would catch and which they'd miss. We want to build a coded dataset of publicly reported incidents involving general-purpose AI models and test the definitions against it. Where your 5 hours/week would help most: 1. Pulling candidate incidents from public incident databases and credible press into a working spreadsheet (target: 50 for a pilot). 2. Helping refine the coding scheme. I have a draft codebook with fields like harm type, severity, near-miss vs. realised harm, and \"would this be reportable under the rule?\" 3. Later, double-coding a sample and computing inter-rater agreement. For now this is a private working project, so please don't share it publicly yet. Would that interest you? If so, I'll send the codebook and we can find 30 minutes to talk it through. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Priya: I emailed her, as you, offering her the data-collection part of this project and asking her to keep it private for now.
